title: Center-based 3D Object Detection and Tracking
grouping: Four data stages captioned (a)-(d) along the bottom (point cloud, map-view features, first stage, second stage), separated by tall narrow rounded network boxes ('3D Backbone', 'Head', 'MLP'). Two thick dark curved arrows arc back from the second-stage features to the map-view feature grid, one over the top and one under the bottom.
shapes_depth: Network boxes are white rounded rectangles with a thick blue outline and rotated labels. The point cloud is a top-down magenta ring render. Map-view features are an oblique 3-D grid of white cubes with grey edges in which a few cells and cuboid columns are outlined in colour (orange, olive, red, green, purple). The first stage shows blue rotated box outlines with dark-red centre dots on a faded point cloud, with grey arrows to boxes whose edge midpoints carry coloured dots. The second stage is a stack of coloured feature cubes -> MLP -> 'score 0.765 / 3D box' with a box outline glyph. Serif captions, sans-serif labels.
proposed_highlight: No module is filled; the colours mark the features sampled per box, repeated on the grid cells, on the box-edge points and on the stacked per-box features, and the feedback is the heaviest stroke in the figure.
lesson: Colour the BEV feature cells that are sampled for each box and repeat those colours on the box-edge points and on the stacked per-box features, with thick dark curved arrows reaching back from the second stage to the grid.
notes: Venue CVPR as recorded by Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); year = arXiv preprint year (2006.11275) and S2 year; the conference year was not confirmed by anything read.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: four data states captioned (a)-(d) left to right (point cloud, map-view feature grid, first-stage centres and boxes, second-stage feature stacks with scores), separated by tall narrow blue-outlined pills for the modules (3D Backbone, Head, MLP)

relations.form: each stage is drawn as its data (a magenta lidar render, a grid of grey 3-D cells, box outlines over a faded point cloud, coloured feature stacks), the modules only thin pills between them
first-stage detections are drawn on the point cloud as blue box outlines with dark-red centre dots, and grey arrows lead to enlarged copies with coloured dots at each face centre

two heavy dark curved arrows run back from the second-stage feature stacks over and under the Head and first stage to coloured cells in the map-view grid, the cell colours matching the face-centre dots and the stacked features
the second stage is drawn twice, one MLP row per detected object, each ending in a score (0.765, 0.436) and a box outline

channels.colour: magenta = raw points; the five accent colours (orange, dark red, green, purple, olive) = individual sampled points, matched across face-centre dots, grid cells and feature stacks; blue = both module pill outlines and predicted 3D box outlines (two meanings)
channels.shape: tall rounded pills = network modules, 3-D cubes = feature cells, rectangles = boxes
channels.line: heavy dark arcs = feature gathering from the map; thin grey arrows = zoom from a box to its sample points
channels.frame: no frames; stages are set off by the module pills and bottom captions

quality.strengths: Every stage is drawn as its real data rather than a box, and the method's point (detect centres, then sample features at box-face centres) is visible as coloured dots that reappear as coloured grid cells and feature stacks; module pills are kept thin so the data takes the space.
quality.weaknesses: The two heavy backward arcs sweep across the Head and the whole first stage, the longest and darkest lines in the figure for a side step; blue marks both modules and predicted boxes; the grid's selected cells do not visibly correspond to locations on the point cloud.

insights.structure: Four data stages left to right, captioned (a)-(d) along the bottom (point cloud, map-view features, first stage, second stage), separated by tall narrow blue-outlined rounded pills ('3D Backbone', 'Head', 'MLP').
insights.data: The input is a real top-down lidar render in magenta; map-view features are a grid of grey 3-D cubes with a few coloured cells; first-stage outputs are blue box outlines with red centre dots over a faded point cloud; second-stage features are a stack of coloured cubes feeding MLPs that output 'score 0.765' and a 3D box.
insights.emphasis: Feature colours tie stages together: the coloured cells sampled in the map-view grid reappear as the coloured cube stacks in the second stage, and two thick dark curved arrows show where they come from.
insights.flow: Left to right through the pills; the two heavy arcs run backwards from the second-stage stacks over the top and under the bottom into the map-view grid.
insights.avoid: The two backward arcs are the heaviest marks in the figure and dominate the forward pipeline; the caption '(a) Point. cloud' has a stray period.

arrangement.units: four unframed data stages, each captioned (a)-(d) at the bottom, separated by tall rounded network pills
arrangement.inputs_as: a real top-down lidar point-cloud render
arrangement.losses_at: none; outputs (score and 3D box) at the right edge
arrangement.shared: coloured feature cells in the map-view grid reused as the second-stage feature stacks
